caption: Sunlight enters a room through a red balloon held up to the window, and a soft red glow falls on the white wall behind it.

sa.check: A red balloon is held up to a window.
A red glow falls on the wall behind it.

pc.expect: The wall looks red only where the balloon's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The wall is red with the balloon off; or stays white under the red light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the balloon and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The wall changes before the balloon; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The glow is one soft patch roughly the balloon's shape.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or floods the wall.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The wall moves; or the balloon moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second balloon appears; or the wall vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wall's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the balloon changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
